name: AttackTarget
description: Make follower(s) attack an enemy: the one named, else the one the player points at, else the nearest.
note: Needs Mantella Living World - Followers and Nether's Follower Framework. Turn off Mantella's own Follow, Unfollow, Wait and Loot. Only offered for members of your Nether's Follower Framework party. Refused if there is no enemy or the target is not an enemy.

target.description: Name of the enemy to attack; leave empty for the one the player points at.

prompt: If the player tells you to attack or kill an enemy, begin your response with '{key}:'
